scope: Conditional CODE rapid observation-time recalibration: satellite code bias, radial PCO, periodic relativity; incomplete physical uncertainty.

conventions.time: GPST; solve t_tx + clock(t_tx) = t_tag - corrected_IF_code/c
conventions.orbit: CODE rapid IGc20; 9-node degree-8 interpolation at 300 s spacing; no extrapolation
conventions.clock: paired CODE rapid 30 s linear interpolation plus -2*r.v/c^2; missing sigma is unknown, not zero
conventions.antenna: IGS20_2425 IF radial PCO; nadir body Z assumed, transverse yaw only bounded
conventions.bias: paired CODE rapid satellite C1C-to-C1W difference; target codes fixed
conventions.calibration: reference sets frozen from bias-corrected broadcast; historical residual/rank/ground thresholds
conventions.controls: 7 orbit nodes and 60 s thinned clocks each recalibrated/refitted; withheld native-node prediction
unresolved: actual attitude and code antenna response
receiver-dependent biases and physical error covariance
absolute clock datum implications for emission time
